'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals''' was a Players Committee constructed regional, 2012, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> Xerox sheets from the tournament-decklists PDF are listed below as those scans are transcribed. The PDF does not name a champion.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 30 June 2012
* '''Winner:''' —
